title: Sung Jang Foo

page_data.en:
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 46
Date ....................................

14th February 1918.

Sir,
It is reported that at No. 18 Vung Tuh Li 文德里 ,
Avenue Dubail there is a band of Northern brigands which
numbers about eighteen persons. They are visited every
three or five days by Sung Jang Foo 宋江甫 alias Yue
Dah Tsu 于大祖 , one of the men wanted for being concerned
in the instigation of the assassination of Admiral Tseng
and for whose arrest a warrant has been issued. These men
all came to Shanghai about a year ago with a number of
others. They totalled about ninety at the time of their
arrival. About fifty have gone back with money which they
have obtained as the proceeds of robberies.
Sung Jang Foo 宋江甫 used to be a resident of Newchang.
He came to Shanghai to see if there was anything to do in
connection with an insurrection which was talked about at
that time and the other members of the band followed him
immediately afterwards on the strength of promises of
employment which he held out to them.
A number of them also live in a house in Chi Yih Li 吉益里
off Avenue Joffre, the number of which is not known.
The robbery at the bank No. 21 Shantung Road wherein
one of the number was caught was carried out by them. One
man whose name is Zia Pau Sie 謝保西 is said to have
obtained $3,000 from the booty. He left Shanghai immediately
and did not share it with the others which caused great
dissatisfaction.
The names of some of the others are Wong Tsu Sai 王祖賽 ,
Tsah Tse Er 蔡子安 , Pih Zay Tung 畢在東 .

Your obedient servant,

William Armstrong

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police. Two men named Tsah Tse Er 蔡子安
& Pih Zay Tung 畢在東 the same form
during & since known as & Curtain to
around, more 31? a member join 21?, are also
reported to be members of the gang. W.A.

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

刑事侦缉处
情报登记
第 46 号
日期 ....................................

1918年2月14日。

先生：

据报，在霞飞路文德里18号，有一伙北方匪帮，人数约十八人。宋江甫（又名于大祖）每三至五天便去探访他们。此人因涉嫌煽动刺杀曾海军上将而被通缉，逮捕令已签发。这伙人大约在一年前与其他一些人一同来到上海。抵达时总人数约为九十人。其中约五十人已带着抢劫所得的赃款返回北方。

宋江甫原籍牛庄。他来到上海，是为了查看当时传闻的起义是否有事可做，其他匪帮成员则基于他所许诺的雇佣机会，随即追随而来。

他们中还有一些人住在霞飞路吉益里的一所房子里，具体门牌号不详。

山东路21号银行抢劫案系该伙人所为，案中一名成员被捕。据说名为谢保西的一名成员从赃物中分得3,000元。他随即离开上海，并未与其他人分赃，此举引起了极大的不满。

其他部分成员的姓名包括：王祖赛、蔡子安、毕在东。

您忠实的仆人，

威廉·阿姆斯特朗

首席侦探督察。

警察总监。

另有两人，名为蔡子安和毕在东，据报也是该帮派成员。（原文此处语句混乱不清，似为OCR错误或笔记残留：the same form during & since known as & Curtain to around, more 31? a member join 21?, are also reported to be members of the gang. W.A.）
